name: Cross-Asset Carry Tilt - Concentrated (Top-2)
description: Ranks the full asset universe by ex-ante carry (expected return from holding with flat prices) and equal-weights only the top 2 highest-carry assets, zeroing all others. More concentrated variant of the full-universe carry strategy. Bonds (VUTY) typically dominate carry rankings due to high yields; equities provide moderate carry via dividends; precious metals and commodities have negative or near-zero carry. Implements concentrated long-only carry factor.
